study.title: Crop Segmentation of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Imagery Using Edge Enhancement Network
study.venue: IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters

dataset.name: Self-built public crop segmentation dataset (Dazhangjiatai, Shahu Town, Xiantao, Hubei)
dataset.note: UAV on-board RGB camera, 11 July 2019, flight altitude 70 m, spatial resolution 0.02017 m/px; original mosaic image 20,954x22,941 px (majority rice); 3 plots selected; manually labeled (LabelMe) into 5 classes: rice, sesame, corn, ground, others; patches 224x224; 877 train / 331 test.

segmentation.backbone: Residual-based Feature Extractor (ConvBlock + BasicBlock + 3 DownBlocks) + Edge/Semantic Enhancer + FFM

mIoU.quote: mIoU is 0.8507 and the F1_score is 0.9088 when EE Strategy is used (ablation); mIoU 0.8097 without
mIoU.ambiguity: Best mIoU = EENet with EE Strategy (ablation-reported in text). Table I (per-method IoU/F1 for 5 classes) and Table II (params/FLOPs) are not text-extractable in this PDF extraction.

F1.quote: F1_score is 0.9088 when EE Strategy is used; F1 0.8778 without
F1.ambiguity: EENet outperforms U-Net/SegNet/PSPNet in mIoU and F1 per abstract; Table I values (incl. class-level) not extractable from text.

Dice.ambiguity: Dice used only in Edge Loss (dice + cross-entropy); reported evaluation metric is F1.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No weed class; 5-class crop/land cover task.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Crop-class F1 values in Table I not text-extractable; overall F1 0.9088 captured under F1.

fps.ambiguity: Only params/FLOPs complexity comparisons (Table II, not text-extractable); no inference-speed measurement.

params_M.ambiguity: Model-complexity advantage claimed vs U-Net/SegNet/PSPNet; exact params in Table II (not text-extractable).

issues: Tables I and II (per-class IoU/F1, params, FLOPs) not text-extractable; headline mIoU/F1 from ablation section only.
